header: The text above a team grid
lead: An eyebrow, heading, lead and rich text, with up to two links. It has no portraits of its own.
bodytext:
This element has no people on purpose. It goes above any team element. Text and faces are separate records, so you can swap a grid for a directory without rewriting the intro.

The band has half the usual space at the bottom, because the element below adds its own top padding. Full spacing on both would make them look like two unrelated sections.
